summary: Frontend-only visual verification of the hand-drawn illustration pass (iteration 7). Verified: (1) Mood page renders 8 unique hand-drawn SVG illustrations for all mood buttons — no emoji present. (2) Dashboard fact-card reactions render IconMindBlown / IconKnewIt / IconHmm SVGs with text labels — no emoji. (3) DidYouKnow card has lightbulb doodle corner, Spotlight card has sparkle corner, WordOfDay card has book corner (all visible). (4) Navbar streak/points/level pills render SVG seedling + bolt + leaf — no 🌱 ⚡ emoji character in navbar text. (5) FunWall post reaction buttons render hand-drawn laugh/heart/eye+clap/fire SVGs — no emoji in reactions row. (6) All 15+ pages navigable without console errors (Dashboard, Leaderboard, Profile, Shoutouts, Help, Music, Polls, Games, Quiz, Learn, Events, Teams, Admin, Mood, FunWall). (7) Login for alex@demo.com and admin@demo.com both work; admin flow reaches Admin Zone with user list. (8) InkDefs and CompanionMascot render (cat mascot visible on dashboard).
